system.description:
"Remind me why I'm bringing you along again?" An Iburi Shinobi states to his partner as they approach a large steel door barricaded with advanced technology. "Sir! Because my skills can get us into the enemy fortress! Sir!" The nervous partner stands upright, sending a small wave of sweat at the Iburi. "Right... Well listen let's hurry on up before we get caught-" In an instant, a chain of smoke explosions appears from far behind the pair, as a myriad of Sand Shinobi emerge. "Ah great. Hidden Sand." The Iburi laces a chained hand scythe with smoke. "Listen man, hurry up and get us in. Wind natures are kind of a problem for me." The Hidden Sand quickly marches towards the two in a loud charge, before a sudden blue flash blinds all, and the Hidden Sand lie incapacitated in a sea of spectral blue swords. The Iburi turns towards his partner, confused. "W-Well...You said that these guys would be trouble for you…Sir!" The Iburi pauses then grins. "Hey kid what's your name?" "Sir! Yugene Genwa! Sir!" The Iburi pats Yugene on the shoulder. "Yugene. I think we're going to be great together."

- Delsan Iburi The Long Road, Ch. 30 excerpt.

Dimension Walkers

Tag: Homebrew, Blasteroid

Formally hailing from the Hidden Rain, members of this clan commonly share an affinity with Lightning, and occasionally, they can manifest something greater. A powerful nature release transformation known as Data Release, which possesses a unique affinity for technology. The Genwa formally worked with the Akatsuki to gather information during the rule of Hanzo of the Salamander. However, after his defeat and the rise of Pain, the Genwa were forced into hiding, eventually splitting from the Rain and scattering themselves among other lands.

Genwa Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Dex Speed: 30 feet. Skill Proficiencies: Ninshou, Sleight of Hand

Tool Proficiencies: Hacker Kit, Security Kit Extra Language: Machine-Speak. You can translate electronic signals transmitted between machines so long as you are in physical contact with either the sending or receiving machine. Passive Affinity: You have the Lightning Release Affinity.

Data Release Techniques: The Genwa Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Genwa Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Radio Tower: You always count as possessing a Radio Link communication tool which doesn’t require a device and instead you can hear and respond to radio transmissions with no tools or equipment. Also, radio-based communication will always work as you function as a radio tower for tools and equipment within 1 mile of you, even if no radio transmissions is possible. Signals originating from you cannot be intercepted or traced using ninja tools.

Genwa Features

Stable Frequency

1st Level Clan Feature

The Genwa clan specializes in utilizing the information that electrical signals transmit, acting as information gatherers as the shinobi world utilizes more modern technology such as radio, Ninja-Net or computers. You’ve learned two different forms which enable you to manifest this information in a destructive way. Your Uplink and Downlink stances. These are separate stances, and you can spend a Bonus action to enter or switch to one of these stances.

Uplink. You have electrical energy radiating off of you, that glows in a neon color your choice. While in this Chakra stance you gain the following benefits;

You can utilize the Angel Link effect of your Hijutsu.

Genwa Hijutsu you cast can originate from any space or creature that is currently Signal Boosted.

When you take the attack action, while in this stance, you can replace attacks made with this action with a Radiant Beam attack.

Radiant Beam. Make ranged Jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you firing a blast of light like energy formed from your lightning release. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu modifier in lightning damage. If you roll an 8 on the damage die of this attack, you or an allied creature within 30 feet of the target becomes Signal Boosted until the end of your next turn. Increase the range of this attack to 60 feet at 7th level and the damage you deal to 2d8 + your jutsu bonus at 15th level. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with this attack, instead of one.

Downlink. You manifest a neon weapon formed of light, that glows in a color your choice. While in this Bukijutsu stance you gain the following benefits;

You can utilize the Demon Link effect of your Hijutsu.

Genwa Hijutsu you cast that affects a creature with ranks of Shocked converts 1 rank of the affected creatures Shocked condition into the Firewalled condition.

Melee weapons you wield that you are proficient in become wreathed in a neon light, infusing them with your unique nature release variant. When you take the attack action using this weapon, you can replace the attacks made with a Radiant Saber attack.

Radiant Saber. Make melee Jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 5 feet of you, as you strike with a beam of light like energy formed from your lightning release. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon Damage] as lightning damage depending on your weapons damage dice, the affected creature becomes Firewalled until the end of your next turn. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks instead of one when you take the Attack action. Beginning at 15th level, increase critical threat range of these attacks by +1.

d4: On a roll of 3 or 4

d6: On a roll of 5 or 6

d8: On a roll of 7 or 8

d10: On a roll of 9 or 10

d12: On a roll of 11 or 12

Data Channels

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Genwa clan specializes tapping into electronic frequencies, such as radio and even data cables from more modern technology such as computers. These are known as data channels. Information networks that the Genwa utilize to become information centers all their own. The Genwa are able to pick up residual packets of information from these data channels, helping to improve their abilities and treating them like free lessons to utilize. When you complete a Long Rest, select a Data Channel from the following and learn their secrets, gaining their listed benefits until you complete your next rest. Beginning at 7th level you can select two channels the benefit from at once. Beginning at 15th level you can switch chosen channels on a short rest.

Hidden Cloud Channel

You have stolen information, tactics and techniques from careless hidden Cloud shinobi that gloat of their impregnable defenses.

When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, gain a rank of Mastery against jutsu with a nature release keyword, until the start of your next turn.

Once per turn, when you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn. This increases to +2 at 11th level.

Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword that you benefit from gain the following effect; For the duration, you become aware if another Sensory effect is within 60 feet of you (or the range of the cast Sensory jutsu, whichever is greater)

Hidden Leaf Channel

You have stolen information from the Hidden Leaf elite on their extreme training regimen and how they and their ability to utilize fire release techniques to guarantee success in battle.

Genwa Jutsu you cast that deal damage, gains a +1 bonus to the damage they deal equal to the number of dice they roll, up to a maximum of +10.

Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu, one allied creature within 30 feet of you gains a d4 bonus to their next saving throw or check. A creature cannot benefit from this effect more than once every minute. This increases to a d6 at 11th level.

Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword that you benefit from gain the following effect; For the duration, you become invisible to Camera’s, sensors and electronic detection devices.

Hidden Mist Channel

You have stolen information from the Hidden Mist elite on utilizing extreme environments to supplement conserving chakra.

Genwa Jutsu you cast have their cost reduced by 1, if you are within the area of effect of; or have been affected by; a jutsu with the lightning release keyword. This cost reduction becomes 2 if you are within 30 feet of a Shocked, Signal Boosted or Firewalled creature.

Once per turn, while you are obscured by the effect of a jutsu you or an allied creature cast, if you move into a space that is not obscured by the jutsu’s effect, you can spend a bonus action to extend it, having the new replicated effect center on you, until the beginning of your next turn.

Jutsu you cast that creates structures or obscurement causes you to be treated as if you are heavily obscured to special senses that rely on sight until the beginning of your next turn.

Hidden Rain Channel

You have stolen information, training methods and infiltration technique from boisterous hidden Rain shinobi that speak highly of their skill and ability.

Genwa Hijutsu you cast count as not having either the HS or CS component, not both. If a jutsu has both, you can pick one at the time of casting.

While concentrating on a jutsu with the lightning release keyword, when you begin your turn, you can spend all of your movement, to select a space you can see within 60 feet of you, that can hold you, and teleport into that space. If you have spent your movement or have less movement available than your maximum, you cannot teleport in this way.

Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword increase their affected area by +15 feet. This increases to +30 at 11th level.

Hidden Sand Channel

You have stolen information, and methods to combat and survive hostile environments from cautious hidden Sand shinobi that speak highly of their techniques.

When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, select a point that you can see within 30 feet of you. You generate a 20-foot radius of protection, granting all creatures within the given area a rank of mastery to checks or saves made to resist hostile environments, or jutsu based effects that affect an area.

At the beginning of each of your turns, while concentrating on a jutsu with the lightning release keyword, you gain bonus DR, equal to your highest ability modifier against the first instance of damage you take before the beginning of your next turn. If you are concentrating on two or more jutsu with the lightning release keyword, you instead gain bonus DR equal to twice your highest ability modifier.

When you cast a jutsu that affects an area and can be concentrated on, you can give the chosen jutsu the Sensory keyword. When you do, for the jutsu’s duration, you gain Tremor sense in the affected area.

Hidden Stone Channel

You have stolen information, and methods to utilize jutsu based constructs in combat, and fortify their positions like a boulder or mountain from confident Stone shinobi that speak highly of their techniques.

When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, that summons a construct, it gains additional hit points equal to the rank its summoned. (D-Rank: +10, C-Rank: +15, B-Rank: +20, A-Rank: +25, S-Rank: +30).

Once per turn, if you are Signal Boosted or a hostile creature is Shocked or Firewalled and are within 30 feet of you, you can dispel the select effect (all ranks if shocked) to gain an additional reaction, which can only be used to cast a jutsu with the lightning release keyword that summons a construct of D-Rank. This becomes C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level.

Constructs you summon with the lightning release keyword gains the Sensory keyword. Constructs with the Sensory keyword gain 60-Feet of vision, and shares that vision with you.

Network Integration

| #### Signal Boosted / Will Amp / You are charged with Data Release chakra and see it upgrading you in the following ways; / Allied Network. The Genwa that applied this status can now see and hear through your senses, as if they shared your perceptive abilities. / Relay Node. The Genwa that applied this status can cast their Hijutsu and have their originate from your space, using your senses to determine what they can see and hear. / Team Link. You radiate a 10-foot radius of neon light, all allied creatures within this radius gain a +1 bonus to their attacks and saving throws. / Signal Degradation. This state degrades quickly, dispelling itself at the end of the Genwa’s turn that applied this status, unless otherwise stated. |

7th Level Clan Feature

Your skill at integrating with radio or data networks has becomes second nature, even to the point of being able to move with said signals to their point of origin. By spending 10 minutes focusing on a radio signal you can sense with your Radio Tower clan trait, yourself and up to 3 willing creatures of your choice begin to have their anatomy changed to match the signal you are focusing on and begin to travel the radio waves, teleporting up to 10 miles closer to the source of the radio waves. This teleportation does not teleport you inside of structures, through barriers or machinery. You end your teleportation as close to the source of this radio signal without penetrating any of the aforementioned inferences. Once you use this feature you cannot do so again until you complete a short or long rest.

Additionally, activities taken with the Hackers Kit, has their DC reduced by 2.

Data Break

11th Level Clan Feature

Your ability to manifest lightning release in the form of a neon light that is a color of your choice, represented by the data you can integrate with, has reached a new height, allowing you to even extract information from an enemies chakra network almost as if it were a mechanical system.

Creatures under the effect of the Firewalled condition, present additional information to you passively. Select one of the following pieces of information that is displayed as if they were followed by neon signs.

One of the creature's attack bonuses.

| Data Leak / [Elemental] / A Data Leaking creature gains vulnerability to one damage type of the inflictors choice. / A Data Leaking Creature increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +8. / Once the affected creatures takes damage of the type, they gained vulnerability to as a result of this condition, they can make a Constitution saving throw vs the Genwa’s highest jutsu save DC. On a success, this condition is dispelled. |

One of the creature's Save DCs.

The creature's lowest saving throw type.

The creatures current hit points.

The creatures current chakra points.

Number of Tenacity Die/ Legendary Resistances.

Data Leak

15th Level Clan Feature

You have learned the ultimate Genwa technique, modifying a creatures physical form as if you are modulating a radio signal, or changing the parameter of a computer system.

When a creature fails a saving throw against a Genwa Hijutsu you cast that inflicts the Firewalled condition, you can use this feature, to instead inflict the Data Leak condition upon them. A creature inflicted with this condition cannot have it inflicted upon them again until they complete a long rest.
